title: NASA Human Integration Design Handbook, Revision 1
text: NASA describes changes in standing stature and seated height in microgravity and notes design allowances of approximately 3% standing and 6% seated. Posture affects anthropometric dimensions.
limitations: Design context, not a clinical threshold or an individual time course. Standing stature and seated height are different measurements.

title: Anthropometric changes and fluid shifts
text: Thornton and colleagues report anthropometric changes observed in Skylab crew members, including height changes during space flight.
limitations: Small historical astronaut population; not a validated individual prediction curve or a direct measurement of a wearable cord.
